Dear YoloMart Procurement Team,

Please find attached our quotation SJ-Q-2201 for the corrugated packaging items in your RFx. Rates are ex-factory, GST extra as shown, validity 30 days.

Regarding the queries in your questionnaire - yes we are ISO 9001 certified (cert available on request), but we do not currently hold FSC or PEFC certification for our board sourcing. Our rejection rate runs about 1.2% on average and we test on a sample-batch basis, not every batch. Recycled fibre content is roughly 20%. We have not gone through an Amazon APASS audit. Standard lead time is 18 working days from PO, and yes, we send a certificate of conformance with every dispatch.

Please let us know if any sizes need revision.
